subject: Order form: tiered usage escalator + capacity add — redlines attached
messages:
From: Katie Mitchell <katie.mitchell@optivexa.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Chu <ben.chu@optivexa.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed capacity add + pricing escalator (redlines attached)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and the cost controls. We're ready to move forward with an initial committed capacity add (12 dedicated units, 12-month term) but procurement needs a couple of changes before legal signs:

- OptiVexa is asking for a pricing escalator tied to usage bands (0-5M tokens, 5-20M, 20M+).
- Need an explicit audit / SOC evidence clause added for our finance audit window in Q4.
- We'd like to cap the annual price increase at 7% (rather than unlimited CPI).

I attached a redlined MSA and a draft order form with the escalator table populated (OptiVexa_Redlines_MSA_20260512.pdf, OrderForm_Draft_v3.xlsx). Can you confirm your review path and an expected approval timeline? Procurement would prefer a single round of redlines + DocuSign if possible.

Also copied Ben Chu (engineering procurement) for any technical clarifications.

Best,
Katie
Katie Mitchell
Head of Procurement
OptiVexa

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed capacity add + pricing escalator (redlines attached)

Katie —

Appreciate the clear ask and the redlines. Quick notes:
- We can support tiered usage escalators; we'll need procurement to confirm whether the bands are forecasted or guaranteed minimums. That affects billing language and credits.
- SOC/audit clause: happy to provide our SOC 2 report and an audit cooperation clause; I'll let legal scope the exact language.
- Cap on annual increases at 7% is reasonable for us to discuss — will route to finance/legal.

Looping in Rishi (legal) and Jonas (solutions/legal ops) to review the redline PDF and propose counter language. Laura, can you confirm whether this is an Enterprise order that needs a sales discount override?

Proposed next steps:
1) Rishi to send specific counter language and a concise summary for procurement to accept or reject.
2) If OptiVexa is ok with the summaries, we aim for one DocuSign package (MSA + Order Form) within 5 business days.

If that timeline works for you, I'll mark this high priority internally.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Monica: +1 (415) 555-0182

--- inline: DocuSign preference: single-package MSA + Order Form
--- inline: Please confirm whether escalator bands are forecast or committed

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Katie Mitchell <katie.mitchell@optivexa.com>, Ben Chu <ben.chu@optivexa.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed capacity add + pricing escalator (redlines attached)

Team —

Reviewed the attached MSA redlines. High-level summary and proposed counters:

1) Pricing escalator: Accept tiered bands but reframe as "usage tiers for unit pricing" rather than an open-ended CPI clause. Proposed language: provide table in Order Form; any annual adjustment limited to a lesser of (i) 7% or (ii) published CPI + 3%. This preserves their ask while capping exposure.

2) Audit / SOC clause: We will deliver SOC 2 Type II report upon NDA, and accept a cooperation clause. We cannot agree to on-site audits without a scoped SOW and cost recovery clause. Proposed counter: virtual evidence + mutually agreed scope for any on-site request and cost reimbursement.

3) Termination for convenience / credits: redline requested by OptiVexa reduces our standard notice window. Propose keeping 90-day notice with pro-rated credits for unused committed units.

4) Effective date & signatures: to keep procurement happy, we can prepare a single DocuSign packet. Legal prefers including a cover page summarizing redline dispositions for transparency.

Attachments: I attached a short "redline disposition" doc (internal) with paragraph-level counters.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm discount approval for the committed 12 units (will determine pricing table).
- Monica: request confirmation from Katie on whether the usage bands are forecasted commitments or purely billing thresholds.

I'll be available for a 30-minute sync if OptiVexa wants to walk through counters.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
--- attachment stub: Redline_Disposition_OptiVexa_20260512.docx (docx, 15KB)

From: Katie Mitchell <katie.mitchell@optivexa.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Chu <ben.chu@optivexa.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed capacity add + pricing escalator (redlines attached)

Thanks Rishi — that approach looks reasonable. A couple clarifications for your counters: 

- The bands are committed forecasted minimums tied to our procurement plan (we commit to the lower bound of each year; spikes beyond are billed at the higher band rate). So your proposed approach to treat the table as the definitive pricing schedule is correct.
- On-site audits: OptiVexa is fine with virtual evidence and a scoped on-site request that includes cost recovery.

We are comfortable with the 90-day notice and pro-rated credits language. Please proceed with the counters and the cover page summary.

If it's helpful, we can join a 30-minute legal sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Katie
